units.question_eng: In what forms shall slavery and the slave trade be prohibited?
units.passage_eng: Everyone has the right to life, liberty and the security of person. No one shall be held in slavery or servitude; slavery and the slave trade shall be prohibited in all their forms. No one shall be subjected to torture or to cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment. Everyone has the right to recognition everywhere as a person before the law. All are equal before the law and are entitled without any discrimination to equal protection of the law. All are entitled to equal protection against any discrimination in violation of this Declaration and against any incitement to such discrimination.

units.question_eng: Until what point is everyone charged with a penal offence presumed innocent?
units.answer_eng: Until proved guilty according to law in a public trial.
units.passage_eng: Everyone charged with a penal offence has the right to be presumed innocent until proved guilty according to law in a public trial at which he has had all the guarantees necessary for his defence. No one shall be held guilty of any penal offence on account of any act or omission which did not constitute a penal offence, under national or international law, at the time when it was committed. Nor shall a heavier penalty be imposed than the one that was applicable at the time the penal offence was committed.

units.question_eng: What does the right to rest and leisure include?
units.answer_eng: Reasonable limitation of working hours and periodic holidays with pay.
units.passage_eng: Everyone has the right to rest and leisure, including reasonable limitation of working hours and periodic holidays with pay. units.passage_tgt: सबकरा के आराम तथा छुघ् मनाबे के अधिकार बा तथा काज करे के समय के सेहो एक उचित सीमा बा तथा समय-समय पर वेतन सहित छुघेि के उपभोग करे के अधिकारो बा। सबहिं के आपन तथा आपन परिवार के स्वास्थ्य आओर कुशलता खातिर एक उचित स्तर पर जीवन-यापन के ठीक-ठीक इंतजाम होखे के चाहीं। बढ़िया जीवन-स्तर होखे खातिर ओकनि के भोजन, कपड़ा, घर, उचित इलाज आओर आवश्यक सामाजिक सेवा ओ शामिल ह। एकरा अलावे बेरोजगारी, बिमारी, अपगंता, वैधव्य, बुढ़ारी एवं ऐसन हालत जे पर ओकर नियंत्रण नइखे, ओ से ओकरा सुरक्षा पावे के अधिकार हड। औरत और बच्चा के अलगे सुविधा आओर सहायता पावे के अधिकार बा। सबहिं बच्चन के चाहे ओकर जन्म कानूनी बियाह के अन्तर्गत भईल हो चाहे बिना बियाह के, समाजिक सुरक्षा मिले के चाही।

units.answer_tgt: काज करे के समय के एक उचित सीमा आओर समय-समय पर वेतन सहित छुघेि।
